title: 第一章从天而降的仙子第二章多子多福系统阴阳问道经
slug: 多子多福照顾女帝一天修为涨一万
lines: “这位仙子，你别开玩笑了，我是不会同意的。”
“让你给就给，哪那么多废话，本小姐以后必将踏入仙界之巅，你还怕吃亏吗？”
“老朽一把年纪，明天就一百岁了，可经不起折腾了。”
陨星谷，山洞。
女子的娇滴滴的声音，一直在李长寿耳畔回荡，这让他心乱如麻，无法安眠。
眼前面色殷红的青衣女子，肤如凝脂，眼眸拉丝。眉眼如画。
而她的对面站着一名身形佝偻，白发苍苍的老者，如风中残烛。
虽然年纪大老了点，但这也让苏千凡看到了希望。
意识逐渐模糊，她摇摇晃晃地摆动娇躯，伸出玉手就要抓住那近在咫尺的希望。
可面前的老者并不为所动，反而是看到鬼一般连忙迅速躲开。
来到洞口，看到女人哼地一声倒在地上，李长寿这才松了口气。
“好家伙，老朽这身子骨差点就散架了。”
前世生日时，发小祝他出门撞大运，他出门还真撞上了，莫名其妙就来到修仙世界。
老天有眼还给他安排了一位姿色上佳的神仙道侣。
这也让他对以后的未来相当期待，以为自己也可以修炼成为仙人，和道侣比翼双飞。
可惜天不遂人愿，前去宗门检测，发现并无修行灵根，反倒是自己的妻子林婉晴检测出中品灵根。
从那一刻，林婉晴就像是变了个人，对他各种嫌弃，每一个举动都充满了绝对的恶意，眼神都多了几分厌恶。
李长寿本想放手，但话还没来得及说出口，就遭到了林婉晴的落井下石。
竟然雇佣了一批刺客前来了结他，这是他万万没想到的。
至此，两人仙凡有别，不得不开启逃亡之路。
没有灵根，注定凡人，他再有不甘，也不得不接受现实。
林婉晴的冷血离开加上破碎的梦想，让李长寿备受打击。
为了防止刺客再寻到他，他最终来到一处荒无人烟的山谷，与世隔绝当山顶洞人，打算平平淡淡过一辈子。
这日，他像往常一样躺在石床上，数起了天上的星星。
正当他数到10086颗时，一股诱人的香味弥漫开来，令得精神一震，紧接着上方洞口处掉下来了一名身穿青衣的女子。
那柔软的娇躯不偏不倚，正好落在了他身上。
还没反应过来，对方还嚷嚷着和他双修，这可让李长寿老脸一红，吓得一个机灵，赶忙把她推开。
自从被林婉晴背叛，李长寿就对女人有了戒心，尤其是这种主动送上门的绝色佳人。
“我去，这女人哪来的。”
苏千凡面色红韵，看到眼前是男人也顾不得年龄，当即伸出玉手。
洞口处的李长寿只觉得身体变得非常轻盈，不受控制的重新飞了回去，直奔苏千凡的怀抱。
那种柔软且富有弹性的冲击感，简直比果冻还要更加q弹，让李长寿忍不住深深吸了一口。
天呐，这女人是仙人！
李长寿只觉得快要窒息，还是第一次见这么奔放的。
面色潮红。
不对...这是中情毒了？
看着眼前媚眼如丝的仙子，以及那隐隐约约间的药香，李长寿当即断定了可能性。
虽未踏入修炼，但他活的够久也积累了不少阅历，这婀娜多姿的女人应是中了逍遥散此类丹药。
想要救助需阴阳调和，方可有一线生机。
content_en:
"Um, ah...give it to me quickly!"
"Fairy, stop joking, I won't agree."
"I'll give it to you, regardless of all the nonsense. This young lady will definitely reach the top of the fairy world in the future. Are you still afraid of suffering a loss?"
"I'm so old. I'll be a hundred years old tomorrow, but I can't stand the trouble anymore."
Meteor Valley, cave.
The woman's delicate voice kept echoing in Li Changshou's ears, which made him confused and unable to sleep peacefully.
The woman in green clothes in front of her has a bright red complexion, her skin is like cream, and her eyes are silky. The eyebrows are picturesque.
Opposite her stood an old man with a stooped figure and gray hair, like a candle in the wind.
Although he was a bit older, this also gave Su Qianfan hope.
Her consciousness gradually blurred, and she swayed her delicate body precariously, stretching out her jade hands to grasp the hope that was so close at hand.
But the old man in front of him was not moved. Instead, he quickly ran away as if he had seen a ghost.
When he came to the entrance of the cave, Li Changshou breathed a sigh of relief when he saw the woman falling to the ground with a groan.
"Good guy, the bones in this old man's body almost fell apart."
On his birthday in his previous life, I wished him good luck when he went out, but he actually met him when he went out and ended up in the world of cultivating immortals inexplicably.
God was wise and arranged for him a beautiful Taoist priest.
This also made him look forward to the future, thinking that he could also cultivate to become an immortal and fly with his Taoist companions.
Unfortunately, things didn't go as planned. I went to the sect for testing and found that there was no cultivation spiritual root. Instead, my wife Lin Wanqing detected a middle-grade spiritual root.
From that moment on, Lin Wanqing seemed to have changed. She disliked him in every way, every move was full of absolute malice, and her eyes were a little more disgusted.
Li Changshou wanted to let go, but before he could say anything, he was insulted by Lin Wanqing.
He actually hired a group of assassins to kill him, which he never expected.
At this point, the two are different from each other and have to start their escape.
Without spiritual roots, he was destined to be a mortal. No matter how unwilling he was, he had to accept the reality.
Lin Wanqing's cold-blooded departure and her broken dream hit Li Changshou deeply.
In order to prevent assassins from finding him again, he finally came to a deserted valley and became a caveman in isolation, intending to live an ordinary life.
That day, he lay on the stone bed as usual and counted the stars in the sky.
Just when he counted to 10086, an alluring fragrance filled the air, making his spirit tremble, and then a woman in green clothes fell from the hole above.
That soft and delicate body was impartial and landed on him.
Before he could react, the other party was still yelling about practicing dual cultivation with him. This made Li Changshou blush, and he was so frightened that he quickly pushed her away.
Ever since he was betrayed by Lin Wanqing, Li Changshou had been wary of women, especially such stunning beauties who came to his door.
"Let me go, where did this woman come from?"
"Man... come back..."
Su Qianfan's face was rosy, and when he saw the man in front of him regardless of his age, he immediately stretched out his jade hand.
At the entrance of the cave, Li Changshou felt that his body had become very light, and he flew back uncontrollably, straight into Su Qianfan's arms.
The soft and elastic impact feeling was even more elastic than jelly, and Li Changshou couldn't help but take a deep breath.
God, this woman is a fairy!
Li Changshou felt like he was about to be suffocated. This was the first time he had seen someone so unrestrained.
Face flushed.
No...is this a Chinese poison?
Looking at the charming fairy in front of him and the faint scent of medicine, Li Changshou immediately concluded the possibility.
Although he has not yet entered cultivation, he has lived long enough and has accumulated a lot of experience. This graceful woman must have been poisoned by pills such as Xiaoyaosan.
If you want to rescue, you need to coordinate the yin and yang to have a chance of survival.
